feature_title: Create a FastAPI URL shortener using uv and Python 3.14 (requires-python >=3.14): POST /links takes a URL validated with Pydantic HttpUrl and returns a 6-character code; GET /{code} redirects with 307; GET /links/{code}/stats returns the hit count; links persist in SQLite through the stdlib sqlite3 module at the path in the SHORTENER_DB environment variable; pytest tests using FastAPI's TestClient, verified by uv run pytest -q.
warnings: get_conn() calls _ensure_hits_table(conn), which runs CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hits on every single request instead of once at startup/connection setup, so every API call pays for a redundant schema check.

create_link's uniqueness check (inside codes.generate_unique_code, which queries db.get_link) and the later db.save_link insert are not atomic: two concurrent requests can pass the collision check for the same code before either inserts, and the second db.save_link call will raise an unhandled sqlite3.IntegrityError (PRIMARY KEY violation) instead of retrying, surfacing as an unhandled 500. Extremely unlikely with a 62^6 code space, but there is no retry-on-conflict or exception handling for it.
